title: Oriented-Hierarchies-SIA: code and data for "Geometrically cohesive oriented hierarchies: exact quadratic computation and limits of a marginal selection"
description:
Code, data and figures accompanying the paper Geometrically cohesive oriented hierarchies: exact quadratic computation and limits of a marginal selection.

  • Exact implementations of the maximum geometric cohesion rule of statistical implicative analysis: full scan, heap (O(n2 log n)) and matrix tournament (O(n2)).
  • The two-stage greedy (marginal) selection.
  • Synthetic campaigns of Section 6 (regimes U, P, O) and the application of Section 7 to three public data sets of test responses (fraction subtraction, ECPE, TIMSS 2003), with bootstrap resampling, inductive item tree analysis and PVAF Q-matrix validation.
  • A notebook (demo.ipynb), a command-line script (code/make_figures.py) and a Streamlit app (streamlit_app.py) that reproduce Figures 1-5 of the paper.

The code is released under the MIT licence. The data sets are redistributed from the R package CDM (version 8.3-14) under its licence, GPL (≥ 2).
